folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B378: later authority and exact proof scope
folds.body:
The full130-row table, S1–S10 nuances and G1–G8 rankings were read. These are dated source-discovery findings: this audit explicitly equates BUILT with code/test presence, not a played route. A missing keyword, module name, directory or unbundled private asset does not establish a missing mechanism; source counts, tool/library status and old reservations retain their dates. Broad capability/idea gaps remain useful investigation questions at their own owners, not mandatory new modules or current build order. Current [PROJECT](../../../PROJECT.md) retains LOTM-first, Harry alongside it, ordinary low-spoiler starts later, and no new Frontier/Mistglass depth.

Row85/S9 overstates what was superseded. AD44 chooses the lead's life as the developer build-through, while retaining other seats and ordinary starts from the same systems. It does not retire independent life, player agency, alternate starts or the character/guide identity dial. Preserve that original breadth; the narrower first-route sequence is not a product impossibility. Rows35/47–49 and the G ranking likewise cannot replace later priorities merely because an older request was frequent.

Later actual-content receipts qualify concrete older uncertainty: the complete [IS1–IS5 checkpoint](../../gm/dispatch/upstream-interaction-system-2026-10-20/CHECKPOINT.md) supplies per-area review and native/browser limits beyond the matrix header; [cultivation correction](../../gm/dispatch/cultivation-spacing-2026-10-22/CHECKPOINT.md) separates screenshot-shaped logs, actual method/purification persistence and later visible Projects proof; [D1 checkpoint](../../gm/dispatch/ui-detail-2026-10-25/CHECKPOINT.md) records real-font matched captures and G1's declared panel prerequisites. The complete [systems guide](../../systems/PROGRESSION_WORLD_STATE.md) qualifies old pack-save-no shorthand with SAVES6d's wired reveal-writer slice, not a played trigger or all-world support. These are attributed bounded receipts, not new browser/source/installed-app verification. AD42 makes human review optional, and old commit/merge/dispatch allowances are not current authorization. Nemesis, identity/luck transfer, worlds, conceptual powers, causal pricing and unusual deaths remain preserved ideas with their own source/implementation questions.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B378: local mechanisms and retained broader lives
folds.body:
All168 table rows, ten subtle-aspect paragraphs and eight ranked gap families were read. Preserve the actual creative distinctions: optional Hanzi presentation versus a wandering controller; simple skills growing beyond a creator-relative benchmark; named local advancement routes instead of a universal ladder; hidden strength and appraisal through actual means; independent companions with their own holders/policies; personal/incomplete techniques; supported nonhuman verbs; voluntary depth instead of a programming language; and powerful means that legitimately change what is possible. Their existence in a palette is useful even when an executor has not been selected. File hits or missing labels do not certify either presence or absence across all native routes.

[Current direction](../../../PROJECT.md) qualifies historical labels and broad recommendations. AD44's developer protagonist route preserves ordinary/alternative lives. AD51 selects useful shared seams without requiring a universal kernel or forcing real world differences into one shape. AD52 compresses repetitive activity while retaining actual choices, costs, work, workers, knowledge and local clocks; convenient play sets no short total-play target. Active play, passive bodily XP, elapsed absence, frozen branches and unused-time banks cannot borrow each other's production entitlement. Food benefits/passive Famine retain their specific owner; the old rate observation is not a new across-system policy or fresh source verification.

Vivid's earlier preference yields to the later Luminous default while preserving player Appearance overrides. Later source/observer/editorial work can qualify old absent-renderer or one-cue findings without proving an entire scene family. The proposed ABR register status remains proposed; a local benchmark, reveal, ritual, bloodline or fragment use needs its actual actor/source/consumer, not a keyword census. Human wording/taste feedback is optional under AD42. Keep the original named palettes, source/qualification gaps, no-other-selves lean and later per-world dials rather than silently discarding them, reviving old source collection/dispatch, or imposing a universal taxonomy, controller or saved density/familiarity system.
